note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Laos: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Salaries are taxed monthly at 0% to LAK 2,500,000, 5% to 5,000,000, 10% to 15,000,000, 15% to 25,000,000, 20% to 65,000,000 and 25% above (annually 0% to 30 million up to 25% above 780 million); sole traders and independent contractors pay profit tax on business income instead.

sources.said: All sole traders and independent contractors are subject to profit tax (PT) on their business income derived in Lao PDR.

figures.finding: PIT is computed monthly; employees now file an annual return by 31 March of the following year.

sources.said: Employees are now required to obtain a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and file annual PIT returns by 31 March of the following year.

figures.finding: Social security is 5.5% from the employee and 6% from the employer on gross pay, on a base capped at LAK 4.5 million a month; expatriates working over 12 months must register.

sources.said: 6% of the gross remuneration must be contributed by the employer. 5.5% of the gross remuneration must be contributed by the employee.
the total base amount to be calculated is capped at LAK 4.5 million.

figures.finding: The employer withholds PIT monthly and pays it by the 20th of the following month; income to artists, athletes and committee members bears 10% withholding.

sources.said: Employers must withhold the PIT payable from their employees' salaries each month and submit the PIT declaration and payment before the 20th (previously 15th) day of the following month.
Income to the committee, artists, athletes-gymnasts, and others 10

figures.finding: Foreigners working in Lao PDR pay PIT on Lao remuneration however short the stay; withholding of 10% applies to income paid to artists, domestic or foreign.

sources.said: Expatriates who work in Lao PDR and obtain remuneration in Lao PDR are obligated to pay PIT, regardless of the period of their employment and stay in Lao PDR.
WHT is applied to various types of payments made to domestic and foreign recipients.
